description: Named Puerto Rico DEM batch profiles for bounded terrain-screening runs. Bounding boxes are operational processing extents, not legal municipal boundaries.

arecibo_utuado.label: Arecibo / Utuado broad pilot bbox
arecibo_utuado.purpose: Initial interior/north-karst-adjacent pilot expansion after one-tile validation.
arecibo_utuado.notes: Broad operational bbox. Do not cite as municipal boundary. Review selected_tiles.csv before processing.

north_karst_belt_west.label: Northern karst belt west broad bbox
north_karst_belt_west.purpose: Karst-interface screening after Arecibo/Utuado gates pass.
north_karst_belt_west.notes: Broad geomorphic processing extent; refine with karst layer before formal use.

central_mountain_corridor.label: Central mountain corridor broad bbox
central_mountain_corridor.purpose: Interior ridge/bench terrain screening after pilot validation.
central_mountain_corridor.notes: Broad terrain-processing extent; not a municipal or administrative definition.

metro_san_juan_edges.label: San Juan metro edge broad bbox
metro_san_juan_edges.purpose: Urban-edge terrain artifact and infrastructure-context calibration.
metro_san_juan_edges.notes: Use mainly for false-positive calibration because urban grading is dense.
